about_the_game:
Embark on an underwater journey full of mystery, beauty, and discovery in Wonders of the Deep. Dive into this third-person 3D adventure where you play as Coral, a young diver determined to continue her father's legacy and uncover the hidden secrets of Atlantis. With the guidance of her inseparable friend Marina from the surface, Coral will explore the ocean's depths, face imposing creatures like sharks, and solve ancient puzzles on her voyage into the unknown.

In Wonders of the Deep, the ocean is both your ally and your enemy. Admire the beauty of marine life, venture into mysterious locations and sunken ruins, and uncover fragments of the past that will bring you closer to the truth behind the legendary lost city.

Your journey will take you through vibrant and varied underwater environments:

  • The Coral Garden, full of color and life.

  • The Kelp Forest, where light barely pierces the dense algae.

  • The Shipwreck, a mysterious sunken vessel filled with secrets.

  • Atlantis, a mythical place hiding the greatest mystery of all.

Key Features:

  • Third-person underwater exploration with vibrant, lifelike, and immersive environments.

  • Environmental and mechanical puzzles that unlock new areas and hidden secrets.

  • Encounters with diverse marine wildlife, from peaceful fish to dangerous predators.

  • Emotional, character-driven narrative, with engaging dialogues between Coral and Marina that deepen their story and relationship.

  • Ruins of Atlantis, designed to evoke wonder and discovery at every turn.
